_widget_categories_about: Brand categories whose logos and buttons sit on ordinary websites as contact widgets, sign-in buttons, map and review embeds, app-store badges or accepted-payment badges. For them a logo, banner or copyright mention is not a claim to be the brand; only the page title counts.
